Runtime instance, ":Class" or ":Class (instance)"; the «human actor» box is the human reviewer
A communication path between two objects; direction is not in the line but in each message label, which names sender -> receiver
Message sequence, nested per UML: messages 1.x are sent while message 1 is being handled
Reply travelling back along the same link to the sender of the numbered call
Message an object sends to itself
Only A6 (main client) and A7 (critic client, a separate instance); A1, A5 and A9 never call the LLM (5.5)
RCA <-> A10 only; every decision enters the system as one whole ReviewRecord through DecisionSubmit, validated by A1 (18.5)
All other agent traffic travels through A1 as EngagementState patches; A6 -> A7 is the single exception (5.3)
Agents never write the queue: A6 returns the ReviewTask in its StatePatch, A1 validates and merges it, then publishes (18.3.1)
